Name: Sir Robert's Houseplants
Author: sirrobertsmom
Description:
[font=Arial][size=4][u][b]Features and Options:[/b][/u]

This is a small collection of  11 houseplants that you can use to decorate your home via Content Patcher and Alternative Textures. The decorative pots are from my previous [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40623]mod[/url] with all new plants!

[size=4]The Content Patcher pack and Alternative Textures pack are in the same download folder for your convenience. All you have to do is unzip it directly into Stardew Valley/Mods and then go wild & crazy with decorating. The images can be found [size=4]under the "Decor/Houseplant" section of the Furniture Catalog or Happy Home Designer. (Each image has Alternative Textures with different decorative pots - this way you will have options depending on your color palette).[/size]

Basically, I can't stop making houseplants because I like to have numerous options and more importantly, I love to have them in a beautiful pot. 

[size=4][u][b]Installation and Usage:[/b][/u][u][b]

[/b][/u][/size][list]
[*][size=4]Install the latest verson of SMAPI[/size]
[*][size=4]Download this mod and unzip it directly into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size]
[*][size=4]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.[/size]
[*][size=4]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿. If you'd like to change the texture of the placed item, you can use the [/size][size=4]Paint Bucket tool on it. This tool is purchasable from Robin.[/size]
[*][size=4][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url]﻿ and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture[/url]﻿ are not required, but I do recommend them. [/size]
[*][size=4]I also recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]﻿ to make life much easier.[/size]
[/list]
[/size][/size][/font]
